gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Commanding up top, with bowls that fill the whole line. Make Righteous small and its bent-rod punch fades, whereas Noto Sans Kayah Li, plain sans with brush ends lifted before curves close, holds up.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Rope-like strokes, bowls that fill the line: that's Righteous at full volume. And Noto Sans Khojki, a sans-serif with wide exits and a large eye on every e, gives the look somewhere to rest.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Pipe-thick strokes, bowls filling the line: Righteous is all swagger, while Noto Sans Khudawadi leaves its rounds unlatched. Loud heading, friendly sans underneath, and the gap is the whole charm.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-lao: A steady, marker-like line carries Righteous, with bowls filling out each row, while Noto Sans Lao rises tall in the lowercase. The draw is plain sans height set against a heading of bent steel.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Fun, mostly: Righteous has stems matching its hairlines because there are none. Shrink it and the weight fades, but Noto Sans Meetei Mayek, a sans-serif with gapped rounds and large eyes, takes larger sizes happily.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Uniform strokes and fat bowls: Righteous looks bent from a single rod. Noto Sans Meroitic, a sans with see-through c openings and lowercase that fills the line, works as its easygoing partner underneath.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-modi: Noto Sans Modi is a sans-serif with daylight inside every curve and capitals barely taller than lowercase. Righteous, though, does the shouting, its wire-constant strokes and wide bowls built for impact where the body just reads.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-mro: Words look dense and tall in the middle here, with generous entrances into each letter. Noto Sans Mro, a sans, would carry paragraphs steadily beneath Righteous, whose bent-rod headings have no hairlines at all.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-newa: Thin steel rod, bent into loud, filled-out bowls. Noto Sans Newa, a sans-serif with a clearly open e and tall counters and bowls, gives the rope-stiff Righteous a more spacious partner underneath.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Commanding and fun, Righteous gives every stroke the same visual weight. But Noto Sans Phoenician, a sans-serif with s curves open at both ends and generous lowercase height, is the one built to be read.
